title: Mushroom Pie
overview: In Broccoli Village, Welsh lives a peaceful life baking pies with Mama Caroni. However, that peaceful daily life comes to an abrupt end following a certain incident.

title: Cheese Omelet
overview: Welsh and his companions barely escaped with their lives after their village was attacked. As they searched for help to save the wounded Welsh, a new encounter awaited them.

title: Licorice Tea
overview: The pursuers targeting Welsh and his companions begin to make their move. Meanwhile, through an old folktale being told, the group comes to realize the sheer scale of the world surrounding them.

title: Caramelized Skewers
overview: With pursuers closing in, Welsh and his companions continue their journey in search of treatment. However, a new danger awaits them. Cornered, the group flees to a certain place.

title: Beef Stewed in Beer
overview: Through a mysterious experience, Welsh and Shedar come face to face with a certain being. With the mission entrusted to them in their hearts, the group embarks on a new journey.

title: Grilled Meats and Seafood
overview: The group continues their journey towards their destination. However, along the way, a series of unsettling events occur.

title: Zabel's Dinner Table
overview: As the ambitions of a formidable enemy unfold, the group ventures into a mysterious place. What awaits them there are memories of the past and a new anomaly.
